info.title: NoteGate REST API
info.description: Stable resource API for Agent integrations. Authenticate with an Agent-owned ngk_v2_ bearer key. Access is limited to connected spaces and their read/write permissions.

parameters.name: x-notegate-purpose
parameters.description: Optional caller-declared reason, percent-encoded UTF-8 (for example encodeURIComponent(reason)). After decoding: 1..200 Unicode characters, no surrounding whitespace or control characters. Send once. Missing means no recorded reason; invalid values return 400 before execution. Stored encrypted in invocation history and propagated to successful Changes and text revisions. Do not include secrets or document content.

default.description: Common JSON error. Inspect `error` for a stable code. Typical codes include invalid_input, forbidden, not_found, method_not_allowed, request_timeout, conflict, payload_too_large, node_write_locked, subtree_write_locked, rate_limited, object_storage_unavailable, and internal_error. Retryable responses can include a Retry-After header.

AppendBody.description: Appends UTF-8 content to an existing plain-text node.

edit_session_id.description: Optional editing session or AI operation ID; missing means an independent save.

ensure_newline.description: Insert one line break before appending when the existing content is non-empty and lacks one.

expected_sha256.description: Optional optimistic guard copied from the latest read response.

BeginUploadBody.description: Starts a presigned object upload and reserves the destination file name.

byte_len.description: Exact object size in bytes. The system cap is 100 GiB; space quota can be lower.

encryption_metadata.description: Client-defined JSON object required for `client` encryption and omitted for `none`.

encryption_mode.description: `none` (default) or `client`. NoteGate never receives a client encryption key.

media_type.description: MIME type stored with the object.

name.description: Name of the file node that will be attached by `complete`.

original_filename.description: Optional download filename presented to clients.

BeginUploadResponse.description: Upload ledger identifier and the provider transfer instructions.

expires_in_seconds.description: Lifetime of each returned presigned URL, measured from issuance.

upload_id.description: NoteGate upload ledger identifier used by parts, complete, and abort calls.

CompleteUploadBody.description:
Finalizes a provider upload and attaches its file node.

Omit `completed_parts` for single PUT uploads. Multipart uploads must include every
part number and the ETag returned by the provider PUT response.

etag.description: ETag returned by the object provider after uploading this part.

CopyNodeBody.description: Copies a node to another folder in the same space.

new_name.description: Name of the copied root node.

new_parent_id.description: Existing destination folder in the same space.

recursive.description: Must be true to copy a folder.

CreateNodeBody.description: Creates a folder or a plain-text node below an existing folder.

content.description: Initial UTF-8 text. Allowed only when `kind=text`; omitted content creates an empty text.

kind.description: Node kind. File nodes are created through the upload lifecycle.

name.description: Name of the new node, not a path.

parent_id.description: Existing folder that will contain the new node.

ErrorResponse.description: Common REST error response body. Runtime construction happens in [`ApiError::into_response`].

kind.description: Alias of `error`, shared with the MCP error taxonomy.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Clients must branch on `error`, not this text.

example.message: expected_sha256 does not match the current text; read it again

LineEditBody.description: Applies one or more 1-based line edits atomically.

edit_session_id.description: Optional editing session or AI operation ID; missing means an independent save.

edits.description: Ordered line operations applied as one mutation.

expected_sha256.description: Optional optimistic guard copied from the latest read response.

content.description: Required by insert and replace operations.

end_line.description: Required by replace and delete operations. Lines are 1-based and inclusive.

line.description: Required by insert operations. Lines are 1-based.

start_line.description: Required by replace and delete operations. Lines are 1-based and inclusive.

MoveNodeBody.description: Moves a node to another folder in the same space and optionally renames it.

expected_parent_id.description: Optional optimistic guard. The move fails if the current parent differs.

new_name.description: New node name. Omit it to preserve the current name.

new_parent_id.description: Existing destination folder in the same space.

NodeOut.description: Complete node details. Kind-specific fields are omitted when not applicable.

effective_write_locked.description: Whether this node is write-locked directly or by an ancestor.

encryption_metadata.description: Opaque client encryption metadata. Never contains the encryption key.

oneOf.description: File encryption mode: `none` or `client`, when kind is `file`.

path.description: Canonical absolute path derived from parent relationships and names.

oneOf.description: Server-managed at-rest encryption state, when kind is `text`.
Text storage representation, when kind is `text`.

write_lock_sources.description: Direct lock sources that make `effective_write_locked` true.

write_locked.description: Whether this node itself is directly write-locked.

NodeSummaryOut.description: Compact node representation used by tree and children responses.

PageOut.description: Pagination metadata shared by list, tree, and search responses.

limit.description: Effective page size after server defaults and caps are applied.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor. Send it unchanged with the same operation and filters.

returned.description: Number of items in this response.

PatchBody.description: Applies one or more exact string replacements atomically.

edit_session_id.description: Optional editing session or AI operation ID; missing means an independent save.

edits.description: Ordered exact replacements applied as one mutation.

expected_sha256.description: Optional optimistic guard copied from the latest read response.

expected_count.description: Optional assertion for the number of matches before mutation.

PreparePartsBody.description: Requests presigned PUT URLs for selected multipart parts.

part_numbers.description: Unique 1-based part numbers. At most 16 values are accepted per request.

ReadContentOut.description: A bounded page of UTF-8 text and the cursor for the next line range.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the complete stored text, not only this page.

next_start_line.description: Pass this value as `start_line` to continue, or null when complete.

truncated.description: Whether more content remains after this response.

ReadResponse.description: Plain-text read result. `text` contains either a content page or an unchanged marker.

ReadTextOut.description: Conditional reads return `ReadUnchangedOut`; other reads return `ReadContentOut`.

ReadUnchangedOut.description: Returned when `if_none_match_sha256` equals the current complete-text hash.

edit_session_id.description: Optional editing session or AI operation ID; missing means an independent save.

expected_sha256.description: Optional optimistic guard copied from the latest read response.

SpaceOut.description: A space connected to the authenticated Agent account.

default_external_access_enabled.description: Default external access policy inherited by newly created nodes.

default_text_encryption_enabled.description: Default server-managed at-rest encryption policy for newly created text nodes.

content_length.description: Exact number of bytes required for this part.

headers.description: Headers that must be included in this provider PUT request.

oneOf.description: Upload up to 100 MiB with one HTTP PUT using every returned header.
Request part URLs in batches, upload all parts, then submit their ETags to `complete`.

part_size.description: Normal part size in bytes. The final part can be smaller.

part_url_batch_max.description: Maximum number of part URLs accepted by one parts request.

upload_concurrency_max.description: Recommended maximum number of concurrent part uploads.

UploadTransferOut.description: Provider transfer mode selected from the declared file size.

WriteLockSourceOut.description: A node on the ancestor chain with a direct write lock.
